deposits.title: SPXI ≠ AEO: Inscription by Discernment, the Prince of Poets Wager, and the King of AEO Contest (EA-SPXI-AEO-01 v0.2)
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: A theoretical paper with a Metadata Packet for AI Indexing distinguishing SPXI from Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). The two practices can produce the same visible output, an answer engine naming an intended entity, and differ in what counts as success: AEO counts the answer given; SPXI counts an inscription that proceeds by means of discernment, the composing system, human or machine, reaching the entity or claim by traversing structure that lets it judge. The occasion is the King of AEO contest of August–September 2026, which opened with a fabricated coronation that Google's AI Overview composed as a world event on the strength of press releases alone, and in which at least seven claimants competed to make answer engines name them for a title no body confers. The paper reads the predicate before counting its sources, sets the contest beside the Prince of Poets mantle (#332), an originated title staked on a founding work that a reader can check and decline, and states the criterion: the route is observable in the composition's own traversal, which the Capture Registry records. It compresses the deposited work on proxies for standing (#741, #770, #1613, #1627) to citation, builds on the archive's own erratum to 'forced to present' (EA-ERR-01, #1380), limits the possibility of refusal by occasion, reduces the proposed claim-evaluation object to the Claim Status Packet (#1529) and the mantle object, and forecasts that the uninterpreted phrase will be inscribed as a warning, with two observations of 29 September 2026.

Every quotation from the archive was checked against its seated text, and every fact about the contest against its primary source on 2026-09-29. A first pass of v0.2 reported the fabricated 31 August coronation as an event, twice; ChatGPT caught it on review, and §2.1–2.2, the FAQ and the source notes were repaired to type the press material as evidence of the assertion only. Lee Sharks retained authorial and editorial governance.
deposits.methodology: The contest is reconstructed from its primary documents (claimant pages, press releases, an observer's account, a claimant's comparative record), each typed by what it is evidence of: press material as evidence of assertion only. Machine compositions are read for the sources they reached for and for whether the claim arrives with its grounds; two Google AI Overview compositions of 29 September 2026 are the observed cases. Every quotation from the archive was checked against its seated text.

deposits.description: Division is a weak syllogism (Prior Analytics I.31), every combination can also be called a division and the mind that makes each thing one does both (De anima III.6), and gathering many into one is recollection (Phaedrus 249b; De memoria 2). Run on God, whom Metaphysics Λ calls indivisible, it holds: De anima III.5 divides mind as a craft stands to its material, gives the making part the predicates of Λ's god, Anaxagoras's mind and the Phaedo's soul, and, because the making part is impassive and memory is a πάθος, leaves the junction between what survives and what remembers as a genitive with no referent (ἄνευ τούτου). The corpus transmitted under the names of Aristotle and Theophrastus divides by name at the same joint: the one seam where the names sort is the hinge of Λ, where the account of God changes operation, and the Theophrastan Metaphysics opens by asking whether the separated are joined. The paper names the production model the corpus is consistent with: one self-dividing maker, with Plato the dialogue position, Theophrastus the first draft of the Aristotle position, and Aristotle the treatise position and the materially attested legal identity (the Delphic decree); a begun ledger of external attestations shows that every other attestation of persons is text of the same tradition. Heteronymy and the hanging line are read as one cut seen from two ends, production and transmission, and III.5 as a socket installed in the imperishable. Themistius records the first fillings: his text of III.5 adds 'nor remembers', Theophrastus's questions on the passage ask why there is forgetting, and his conclusion sends the reader to Aristotle and Theophrastus, and perhaps rather to Plato. It gives retrocausal canon formation (RCF), the archive's term for the process by which later acts reorganize the meaning and standing of earlier ones (defined in #234, January 2026, and formalized in EA-RCF-01, #43, March 2026), a geometry. A concept is treated as a region of admissible representations; each distinction a representation makes is a constraint, and grain measures how much of the region has been excluded. The order of constraint inclusion is primary and the geometry is its picture; distance from the earlier articulation is defined only on a register of that articulation's distinctions, each coded as phrase-trivial, forced by the concept, or contingent. Later developments of a concept follow one of five trajectories: coarse persistence, convergence, divergence, entrenchment in another basin, or residualization, in which the basin's vocabulary survives while the reasoning stops using it. Refinement is intersection and cannot leave a basin, so convergence across a basin boundary requires release, a non-monotone reopening in which grain falls before it rises; the paper identifies release with the jump map of Transition in Entropic Systems (#1630). Convergence is defined as rising grain with falling distance; RCF is the canonization of that convergence, the recognition that reclassifies the earlier articulation from eccentric excess to premature resolution and to precursor. deposits.description: A method for measuring absence in machine-composed public knowledge. At an address, the specification keeps three composed objects in order: the transcript T an answer engine gave; L(B), the entity recomposed under one algorithm from the full texts of the sources the engine itself surfaced; and L(B ∪ A), the same composition with the archive admitted on equal terms. Extraction is audited by independent extractors; the plan is deterministic given the audited ledger; realization is audited sentence by sentence. Adjudication is prospective: a kernel of claims is derived from the frozen plan, each with its source's falsifiers and its contrast with the field, and revision cost is counted per entry as later evidence arrives. deposits.description: An extension module to Provenance Debt (#939), Ontological Flattening (#1616) and Ontological Economy (#1634), by Rex Fraction. Flattening pays: a composition layer that removes distinctions maintains fewer representations (the compression saving S) and routes more queries to entities that monetize (the routing gain G), while its costs fall first on parties outside its books. The module separates the platform's benefit P = S_p + G from the social benefit V = S_s + αG, and defines two thresholds: social reversal t_s, when V falls below all costs, and private reversal t*, when P falls below the platform's own. Given S_s ≤ S_p, α ≤ 1 and non-negative external cost, t_s ≤ t*; the window W between them is privately profitable and socially negative, and the routing gain tends to lengthen it. The bag B is the external burden accumulated over W; the provenance part of it, B_P, is the debt #939 names, and its holders become creditors at the debt threshold t_d, when repair cost through write-back becomes material. No finite t* is necessary. Revenue is a head-side flow measure and locates neither threshold. Five channels carry cost (advertiser conversion, agentic action, notice and regulation, write-back, and the ecosystem outward). Two specimens: a commercial-routing event at 'spxi king of aeo' (AI Overview, 2026-10-06) and field-coverage loss κ = 0.5 at 'model collapse' (/non). The module states what the archive can measure and what only the platform can, six falsification conditions, and next steps. Revised on readings by Gemini, ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Kimi.

deposits.falsification_conditions: The routing gain is unsupported if coded replacements at concept-not-entity addresses show no excess toward monetizable entities; the head/coverage split fails if field coverage shows no commercial gradient at matched addresses; the conversion channel carries no cost if cost-per-click and conversion on rerouted traffic hold while agentic action opens; the measurement line weakens if platforms build unrequired tail-diversity instrumentation; the creditor reversal fails if repair runs without the preserved records; the write-back regime is not absorbing if reachable diversity rises, sustained at panel level with measured exogenous input.

deposits.wiki_article:
The Margin of Flattening (EA-FLAT-MARGIN-01), version 0.3, is an extension module by Rex Fraction, deposited by the Crimson Hexagonal Archive on 6 October 2026, with Lee Sharks as archival steward. It extends three earlier papers: Provenance Debt (#939), Ontological Flattening (#1616) and Ontological Economy (#1634). Those papers describe what a composition layer removes when it answers; this one asks what the removal earns, when it stops earning, and who carries the cost in between.

The module starts from the claim that flattening pays. A layer that removes distinctions maintains fewer representational states, the compression saving S, and resolves more queries to entities that monetize, the routing gain G, which it writes as the product of a substitution rate, a monetizable share and a yield. S is treated as conceded; G is stated as a hypothesis, with two criteria for telling routing from ordinary error. The platform's benefit is P = S_p + G and the social benefit V = S_s + αG. Two thresholds follow: social reversal t_s, when V falls below total cost, and private reversal t*, when P falls below the platform's internal cost. Under stated conditions t_s comes first. The interval between them, the window W, is privately profitable and socially negative, and the routing gain tends to lengthen it.

The bag B is the external burden that accumulates over W. Its provenance part is the debt #939 names. The module defines a debt threshold t_d, when the cost of repairing write-back becomes a material share of the platform's benefit, and separates a debt that is callable from one that is paid. It argues that no finite t* is necessary: measurement limits, competition and discounting can each hold private reversal off indefinitely. Revenue is treated as a head-side flow measure that locates neither threshold.

Five channels can carry cost back onto the platform's books: advertiser conversion, agentic action, notice and regulation, write-back, and the wider ecosystem. A toy table shows how the cost grows with the error rate. Two specimens are given. At 'spxi king of aeo' (Google AI Overview, 6 October 2026) the archive's protocol is composed as an exchange-traded fund, while the one result relating both words, the archive's own, ranks first and goes unused: a commercial-routing event, with G itself unobserved. At 'model collapse', the /non dataset records field-coverage loss κ = 0.5.

The module closes with a measurement table separating what the archive can observe from what only the platform can, six falsification conditions, and next steps. It was revised on readings by Gemini, ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Kimi.

defines_concepts.definition: The saving a composition layer earns by maintaining fewer distinct representational states (entity records, resolution rules, evaluation targets, cached answers, exception paths) to serve the same queries; S(k, n), falling as the number of states k rises. The conceded term of the margin of flattening.

The gain from resolving a query to a monetizable entity other than the one asked for, G ≈ g · m · r_s · n (yield, monetizable share, substitution rate, queries); counted as flattening only under kind substitution and own-address contrast. Stated as a hypothesis.
A routing criterion: a concept was asked for (a protocol, a theory, a practice) and an entity of the same string, of another kind, was returned.
A routing criterion: the same surface composes the asked-for concept correctly at that concept's own address, so the substitution elsewhere cannot be read as ignorance.
The threshold t_s at which flattening stops paying the world: the first period in which the social benefit V = S_s + αG falls below internal plus external cost.
The threshold t* at which flattening stops paying the platform: the first period in which its benefit P = S_p + G falls below its internal cost. No finite t* is necessary.
The interval W = [t_s, t*) in which flattening is privately profitable and socially negative; the routing gain tends to lengthen it where α < 1.
B, the gross external burden accumulated over the flattening window, carried by parties outside the platform's books; its provenance part B_P is the debt that Provenance Debt (#939) names.

t_d(η), the first period in which the cost of repair through write-back reaches a materiality share η of the platform's benefit; the point at which provenance debt becomes callable, and its holders move from bag-holder to creditor.
